reviewDecisions.rationale: Aggregate demand fell sharply while technical thresholds rose; deep research must separate policy losers from technology/quality exceptions.
Late-Q1 spot tightness is source-linked and new relative to an earlier improved baseline; this is a direct V1.9 fresh-route test if company economics and expectations qualify.
Record February demand is powerful but explicitly continuation; it must pass inherited rules without V1.9 relaxation.
Strong global product economics remain a useful causal-mapping control; domestic proxies must still fail closed without current DRAM earnings.
Repeated TiO2 hikes test whether strong earnings can pass inherited gates while V1.9 fresh escalation remains forbidden.
A real commodity cycle with extreme product/equity absorption is a direct test of expectation discipline.
